renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Mind is the mantra. Trying is what gets it done. Wisdom is your body — that is the mantra's secret. Inside, the mind unfolds, dreaming a wisdom you cannot yet tell apart. Wisdom rising on its own: skywalking, god-state.
